nodes.label: Gnomo (Woman) 2D Sprite
nodes.description: Full-body, front-facing 2D character illustration on a transparent/white canvas with the figure in the lower portion. A female gnome with pointed ears, wavy auburn hair and green eyes, hands on hips in a confident stance. She wears an olive-green tunic, a draped grey-brown cloak, a leather crossbody strap with brass buckles and a leather satchel, dark maroon breeches, wrapped shins and brown boots. Clean line-art with flat cel shading, an earthy forest palette.

nodes.label: Gnome Character (Female Variant)
nodes.rationale: Selectable fantasy character type for the 'woman' sprite set; placement in sprites-2d/woman suggests characters are organized by gender, with a gnome being one of the available character archetypes.

nodes.label: Forest Adventurer Attire
nodes.rationale: Cloak, satchel, leather straps and boots in earthy greens and browns match a mountain/forest theme (project name 'Brillo en la Montana'), giving the character a traveler/explorer identity.
